scale: 1 weak to 5 strong; ordinal reasoned judgments, not empirical effects or acceptance probabilities. Means are transparent prioritization heuristics only. Hard gates override rank.

candidates.title: Medical Readouts under Matched Supervision: Calibration, Selective Risk, and Capability Interference
candidates.rationale: Separates readout, decision supervision and maintenance objective with same-backbone probes and cross-family replication. Visual Jev, Dyad, Uni-Med and Med-MoE-LoRA may reduce the contribution to replication; no new paradigm is claimed.

candidates.title: Evidence-Conditioned Calibration Transport under Medical Source Failures
candidates.rationale: Study transfer of a fixed calibration map across clinically valid source failures. CLEAR, CliniCARE, MemSafe, Visual Jev, SURE-RAG and RULE cover most primitives; a generic evidence-aware head or benchmark is rejected as novelty.

candidates.title: Calibration-preserving merging under noncompensable medical constraints
candidates.rationale: OptMerge, Expert Merging, uncertainty-aware merging and safety degradation already threaten merging novelty. Requires compatible lawfully usable experts and clinically defensible hard gates; zero-cost feasibility is low.

candidates.title: Native calibrated medical decision head
candidates.rationale: Dyad, Chinese-Jev and Visual Jev directly threaten native-head novelty. Visual Jev reports no consistent typed-head advantage under a matched control. A head alone is not a contribution.

candidates.title: Medical capability per byte and joule
candidates.rationale: Parameter count is an inadequate systems endpoint. Hardware energy measurement and medical retention margins are not available. A static byte estimate cannot establish a Pareto frontier.

candidates.title: Arabic/English medical selective calibration
candidates.rationale: BiMediX, MedAraBench, MedArabiQ, Chinese-Jev and cross-lingual consistency studies make multilingual extension incremental unless semantic equivalence and calibrated transport are rigorously established. Qualified bilingual annotation is a boundary.

candidates.title: Semantic encoder replacement for understanding and image generation
candidates.rationale: PixelUMM and unified models threaten encoder-removal novelty; Qwen-Image conditioning is more than width matching. A stronger resource result needs real hardware and licensed image evidence.

candidates.title: Single-checkpoint heterogeneous capability fusion
candidates.rationale: MedUAG, UniMedVL, SynerMedGen, BAGEL, PixelUMM already unify capabilities; no evidence that consolidation causes a clinical gain. Large heterogeneous rights/runtime burden.

selection: T5 primary; T7 secondary; T3 optional follow-up
